title: Descobrir Explorer Semantic Payload
description: Skill-local closed contract for one untrusted Explorer payload over a single deterministic chunk. The Explorer is the only stochastic stage and is confined to semantics: it references stable opaque chunk/node/edge keys and supplies type, natural_key, name, summary, and bounded attributes. It must never supply authority owned by deterministic prepare/finalize: canonical ids, hashes, artifact manifest, coverage, status, acceptance, source_engine, evidence, repository/source paths. Every object is closed (additionalProperties:false) so any smuggled authority or prompt-injection-shaped field is rejected structurally. Merge, canonical ids, graph hash, coverage, verification and status promotion are all downstream and deterministic.

chunk_key.description: Stable opaque identifier of the deterministic chunk this payload interprets. Assigned by prepare, never by the Explorer.

records.description: Semantic interpretations of graph nodes in this chunk. Never carries canonical ids, status, evidence, or source_engine.

relations.description: Relation intents between records. Endpoints are named by (type, natural_key); canonical endpoint ids are recomputed downstream.

opaqueKey.description: Bounded opaque token (chunk/node/edge). Forbids slash, backslash, dot and whitespace so it can never carry a source path or repository reference.

semanticName.description: Single-line semantic token (type, name, relation_type). No control characters, no leading slash, no backslash.

naturalKey.description: Semantic natural key. May contain ':' and '/' (e.g. get:/billing) but rejects a leading slash, '..' traversal, backslash and control characters, so it cannot be an absolute path.

summary.description: Short single-line factual summary. May be empty. No control characters or newlines.

attributeValue.description: Bounded scalar attribute value. Nested objects and arrays are rejected so authority structures cannot be smuggled through attributes.

attributes.description: Open map of bounded scalar semantic attributes. Keys are snake/dotted tokens; values are scalars only.

node_key.description: Opaque reference to the deterministic graph node this record interprets.

edge_key.description: Opaque reference to the deterministic graph edge this relation interprets.
